chapter: Violin, the 1936 tour and the photo
title: Pierron the violinist and his written tunes
summary: Discussion of violinist Pierron, whose music the band bought, and tunes such as Sister Kate and New Orleans Wiggle.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: I met a couple of fellas out of the band. You know? Well, Alvin Alcorn used to play with him some. He played with you.
Now Pierron, was he living at the time? Where's his band? Well he played the violin. Yeah? He hadn't been dead all that long, you know?
But that was after Alvin wrote you. He used to write music. We bought some of his music.
I can't remember. Sister Katie wrote, Mama's Gone Goodbye. Here on, let's see. Blue Orleans Wiggle, I think he did that one.
